body: idunaclient.New() wired into world. CharCache (var/mud-chars.json) maps name→character_id across sessions. Login: GetCharacter(cachedID) or CreateCharacter; restores level/xp/gil. Disconnect: UpdateCharacterLevel + UpdatePosition. CreateCharacter/UpdateCharacterLevel added to idunaclient package.
title: S98-01/02: MUD IDUNA character persistence — fetch-or-create on login, save on disconnect
